title: Class C departure: clearance delivery to departure

briefing.description: Busy airspace now. Departing a Class C airport VFR means one extra stop before Ground: Clearance Delivery. You'll copy a departure clearance (heading, altitude, departure frequency, squawk) and read all of it back, then work Ground, Tower, and finally check in with Departure. Copy carefully — this is the longest readback you've done.
briefing.atisText: Metro International information {atis}. Wind {wind_dir} at {wind_kt}. Visibility one zero. Sky clear. Altimeter {altimeter}. Departing runway {rwy}. VFR departures advise Clearance Delivery of direction of flight. Advise on initial contact you have information {atis}.

steps.speaker: ATIS
steps.text: Metro International information {atis}. Wind {wind_dir} at {wind_kt}. Visibility one zero. Sky clear. Altimeter {altimeter}. Departing runway {rwy}. VFR departures advise Clearance Delivery of direction of flight. Advise on initial contact you have information {atis}.
ATIS copied. Pen ready — you tune Clearance Delivery, 118.9.

steps.prompt: Call Clearance Delivery: who you are, where you're parked, ATIS, and your request — VFR to Cedar Valley at 4,500.
steps.hint: Metro Clearance, Skyhawk {callsign}, at the east ramp with information {atis}, request VFR departure to Cedar Valley at four thousand five hundred.

elements.label: addressing Metro Clearance
elements.feedbackMissing: Address the facility: “Metro Clearance”.

elements.label: your callsign
elements.feedbackMissing: Include your full callsign on initial contact.

elements.label: the ATIS code
elements.feedbackMissing: Report the ATIS: “with information {atis}”.
elements.feedbackWrong: You said information {heard}, but the current ATIS is {atis}.

elements.label: the VFR departure request
elements.feedbackMissing: State the request with direction/destination: “request VFR departure to Cedar Valley”.

elements.label: requested altitude
elements.feedbackMissing: Include your requested cruise altitude: “at four thousand five hundred”.
elements.feedbackWrong: You requested {heard} feet — the plan was 4,500.

steps.speaker: Clearance
steps.text: Skyhawk {callsign}, Metro Clearance. Cleared out of the Metro Class Charlie airspace. On departure, fly heading {hdg}, maintain at or below two thousand five hundred. Departure frequency one one niner point two, squawk {squawk}.

steps.prompt: Read back the full clearance: heading, altitude restriction, departure frequency, and squawk.
steps.hint: Heading {hdg}, at or below two thousand five hundred, departure one one niner point two, squawk {squawk}, Skyhawk {callsign}.

elements.label: heading readback
elements.feedbackMissing: You missed the assigned heading — read back “fly heading {hdg}”.

elements.label: altitude restriction readback
elements.feedbackMissing: You missed the altitude restriction: “at or below two thousand five hundred”.
elements.feedbackWrong: You read back {heard} feet, but the restriction is at or below 2,500.

elements.label: departure frequency readback
elements.feedbackMissing: You missed the departure frequency: “one one niner point two”.
elements.feedbackWrong: You read back {heard}, but departure is on 119.2.

elements.label: squawk readback
elements.feedbackMissing: You forgot to read back the squawk code.
elements.feedbackWrong: You read back {heard}, but the assigned squawk is {squawk}.

elements.label: your callsign
elements.feedbackMissing: End the readback with your callsign.

steps.speaker: Clearance
steps.text: Skyhawk {callsign}, readback correct. Contact Ground point niner when ready to taxi.
Transponder set to {squawk}. You switch to Ground, 121.9.

steps.prompt: Call Ground for taxi. You're at the east ramp with your clearance.
steps.hint: Metro Ground, Skyhawk {callsign}, east ramp with {atis} and clearance, ready to taxi.

elements.label: addressing Metro Ground
elements.feedbackMissing: Address the facility: “Metro Ground”.

elements.label: your callsign
elements.feedbackMissing: Include your callsign.

elements.label: your position
elements.feedbackMissing: Tell Ground where you are: “east ramp”.

elements.label: the taxi request
elements.feedbackMissing: Say the request: “ready to taxi”.

steps.speaker: Ground
steps.text: Skyhawk {callsign}, Metro Ground, runway {rwy}, taxi via bravo, hold short of runway {rwy}.

steps.prompt: Read back the taxi instruction — including the hold short.
steps.hint: Runway {rwy} via bravo, hold short runway {rwy}, Skyhawk {callsign}.

elements.label: runway readback
elements.feedbackMissing: You forgot to read back the runway assignment.
elements.feedbackWrong: You read back runway {heard}, but Ground assigned runway {rwy}.

elements.label: taxi route readback
elements.feedbackMissing: Read back the route: “via bravo”.

elements.label: hold-short readback
elements.feedbackMissing: Hold-short instructions must always be read back word for word — “hold short runway {rwy}”.

elements.label: your callsign
elements.feedbackMissing: End the readback with your callsign.

steps.text: Run-up complete, holding short of runway {rwy}. Ground hands you to Tower on 120.5.

steps.prompt: Call Tower — holding short of runway {rwy}, ready for departure.
steps.hint: Metro Tower, Skyhawk {callsign}, holding short runway {rwy}, ready for departure.

elements.label: addressing Metro Tower
elements.feedbackMissing: Address the facility: “Metro Tower”.

elements.label: your callsign
elements.feedbackMissing: Include your callsign.

elements.label: holding short report
elements.feedbackMissing: Report your position: “holding short runway {rwy}”.

elements.label: ready for departure
elements.feedbackMissing: State the request: “ready for departure”.

steps.speaker: Tower
steps.text: Skyhawk {callsign}, runway {rwy}, line up and wait — traffic crossing downfield.

steps.prompt: “Line up and wait” means take the runway but do NOT depart. Read it back.
steps.hint: Runway {rwy}, line up and wait, Skyhawk {callsign}.

elements.label: line up and wait readback
elements.feedbackMissing: Read back “line up and wait” exactly — never confuse it with a takeoff clearance.

elements.label: runway readback
elements.feedbackMissing: Include the runway in the readback.
elements.feedbackWrong: You read back runway {heard}, but the instruction was for runway {rwy}.

elements.label: your callsign
elements.feedbackMissing: End the readback with your callsign.

steps.speaker: Tower
steps.text: Skyhawk {callsign}, runway {rwy}, cleared for takeoff, fly heading {hdg}.

steps.prompt: Read back the takeoff clearance and heading.
steps.hint: Cleared for takeoff runway {rwy}, heading {hdg}, Skyhawk {callsign}.

elements.label: takeoff clearance readback
elements.feedbackMissing: Read back the clearance: “cleared for takeoff”.

elements.label: runway readback
elements.feedbackMissing: Read back the runway with the clearance.
elements.feedbackWrong: You read back runway {heard}, but you're cleared on runway {rwy}.

elements.label: heading readback
elements.feedbackMissing: Read back the assigned heading: “fly heading {hdg}”.

elements.label: your callsign
elements.feedbackMissing: End the readback with your callsign.

steps.text: You depart runway {rwy} and turn to heading {hdg}, climbing through 1,200 feet.

elements.label: handoff acknowledgment
elements.feedbackMissing: Acknowledge the handoff — “over to Departure” with your callsign.

elements.label: your callsign
elements.feedbackMissing: Include your callsign.

steps.speaker: Departure
steps.text: Metro Departure — frequency is busy with airline traffic. You find a gap.

steps.prompt: Check in with Departure: callsign and altitude (passing 1,500, climbing to your restriction 2,500).
steps.hint: Metro Departure, Skyhawk {callsign}, one thousand five hundred climbing two thousand five hundred.

elements.label: addressing Metro Departure
elements.feedbackMissing: Address the facility: “Metro Departure”.

elements.label: your callsign
elements.feedbackMissing: Include your callsign.

elements.label: altitude report (climbing to)
elements.feedbackMissing: Report your altitude and what you're climbing to — Departure verifies your Mode C with it.
elements.feedbackWrong: You reported climbing to {heard} feet, but your restriction is 2,500.

steps.speaker: Departure
steps.text: Skyhawk {callsign}, Metro Departure, radar contact. Leaving the Class Charlie, resume own navigation, altitude your discretion. Good day.

steps.prompt: Acknowledge — you're free to navigate and climb on course.
steps.hint: Resume own navigation, altitude my discretion, Skyhawk {callsign}. Good day.

elements.label: acknowledgment
elements.feedbackMissing: Acknowledge the instruction: “resume own navigation”.

elements.label: your callsign
elements.feedbackMissing: End with your callsign.
